name: Question 2
worked_solution:
If $F=P\,i+Q\,j+R\,k$ is a vector field on ${R}^{3}$ and the partial derivatives of the components of $F$ all exist, then the curl of $F$ is the vector field given by

$$
curl\,F=∇\times F=|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ \frac{∂}{∂x} & \frac{∂}{∂y} & \frac{∂}{∂z} \\ P & Q & R\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{curl}\,F & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ \frac{∂}{∂x} & \frac{∂}{∂y} & \frac{∂}{∂z} \\ x & 2y & 3z\end{aligned}| \\  & =[\frac{∂}{∂y}(3z)-\frac{∂}{∂z}(2y)]i-[\frac{∂}{∂x}(3z)-\frac{∂}{∂z}(x)]j+[\frac{∂}{∂x}(2y)-\frac{∂}{∂y}(x)]k \\  & =(0-0)\,i-(0-0)\,j+(0-0)\,k \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 2
?

Given that F(x,y,z)=xi+2yj+3zk, what is curlF?

a
i+2j+3k
b
0
c
−i+2j−3k
d
−3yi+2xj−zk
e
3j−2k
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

If F=Pi+Qj+Rk is a vector field on R3 and the partial derivatives of the components of F all exist, then the curl of F is the vector field given by

curlF=∇×F=|ijk∂∂x∂∂y∂∂zPQR|.

Therefore, we have

curlF=|ijk∂∂x∂∂y∂∂zx2y3z|=[∂∂y(3z)−∂∂z(2y)]i−[∂∂x(3z)−∂∂z(x)]j+[∂∂x(2y)−∂∂y(x)]k=(0−0)i−(0−0)j+(0−0)k=0.
